name: Hermit
intro: The Hermit pathway seeks hidden knowledge and mystical scholarship, wielding rituals, spells and arcane discoveries to solve problems or destroy enemies.

meter.name: Knowledge
meter.full: Release one owned scroll separately from its original cooldown

ability.name: Secret Vision
ability.label: Passive
ability.description: Secret Vision — +10% INT; +25% Curse application resistance. Passive.

ability.name: Mystic Spell
ability.label: Active
ability.description: Mystic Spell — Deals 130% INT Mystic damage (25% base DEF bypass); 40% chance to apply one of Freeze, Burn, Stunned for 1 turns; Damage and hostile effects use accuracy and Dodge; critical, authority and defense modifiers still apply. 15 SP · Cooldown 1 turn.

ability.name: Scroll Ward
ability.label: Active
ability.description: Scroll Ward — Grants a 20% Max HP magic shield; lasts until depleted or dispelled; If the resolved cast deals no damage, follows its utility effects with a 35% basic strike against the current enemy. 25 SP · Cooldown 3 turns.

ability.name: Knowledge Arrow
ability.label: Active
ability.description: Knowledge Arrow — Deals 160% INT Elemental damage (25% base DEF bypass); resistance uses the average of Fire, Water, Lightning and Frost; +20% DEF bypass on this cast; From Sequence 6, prepare one owned spell scroll. At 100 charge, release it at full strength with original SP cost independently of its source cooldown.; Damage and hostile effects use accuracy and Dodge; critical, authority and defense modifiers still apply. 35 SP · Cooldown 2 turns.

ability.name: Constellation Constrain
ability.label: Active
ability.description: Constellation Constrain — Enemy SPEED −25% for 2 turns; 100% chance: Bound (blocks actions) for 1 turn; subject to status resistance and immunity; If the resolved cast deals no damage, follows its utility effects with a 35% basic strike against the current enemy. 45 SP · Cooldown 3 turns.

ability.name: Fairy Tale Spell
ability.label: Active
ability.description: Fairy Tale Spell — Deals 180% INT Mystic damage (25% base DEF bypass); 100% chance: Polymorphed (blocks actions) for 1 turn; subject to status resistance and immunity; Damage and hostile effects use accuracy and Dodge; critical, authority and defense modifiers still apply. 50 SP · Cooldown 3 turns.

ability.name: Mystic Domain
ability.label: Active
ability.description: Mystic Domain — Increases your outgoing damage by 20% for 2 turns; If the resolved cast deals no damage, follows its utility effects with a 35% basic strike against the current enemy. 70 SP · Cooldown 4 turns.

ability.name: Scroll Gate
ability.label: Active
ability.description: Scroll Gate — Deals 270% INT Mystic damage (25% base DEF bypass); Reflects 50% of incoming damage to the attacker until your next turn; periodic damage does not trigger reflection; Damage and hostile effects use accuracy and Dodge; critical, authority and defense modifiers still apply. 85 SP · Cooldown 4 turns.

ability.name: Star Knowledge
ability.label: Active
ability.description: Star Knowledge — Deals 320% INT Elemental damage (25% base DEF bypass); resistance uses the average of Fire, Water, Lightning and Frost; Damage and hostile effects use accuracy and Dodge; critical, authority and defense modifiers still apply. 100 SP · Cooldown 4 turns.

ability.name: Eye of Knowledge
ability.label: Active Authority
ability.description: Eye of Knowledge — Deals 400% INT True damage (ignores DEF and elemental resistance); Damage and hostile effects use accuracy and Dodge; critical, authority and defense modifiers still apply. 120 SP · Cooldown 5 turns.
